mapper.select: select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as workorderCount, sum(plan_quantity) as planQuantity, sum(completed_quantity) as completedQuantity, round(sum(completed_quantity) / sum(plan_quantity) * 100, 1) as completionRate from pro_workorder where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status = 'RELEASED' then 1 else 0 end) as released, sum(case when status = 'PRODUCING' then 1 else 0 end) as producing, sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when status = 'CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end) as closed, count(*) as total from pro_workorder where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when status = 'CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end) as closed from pro_workorder where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 12 month) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by month

select (select count(*) from qc_iqc where inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as iqcCount, (select count(*) from qc_iqc where inspect_result = 'PASSED' and inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as iqcPassed, (select count(*) from qc_ipqc where inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as ipqcCount, (select count(*) from qc_ipqc where inspect_result = 'PASSED' and inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as ipqcPassed, (select count(*) from qc_oqc where inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as oqcCount, (select count(*) from qc_oqc where inspect_result = 'PASSED' and inspect_date >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as oqcPassed, (select count(*) from qc_defect_record where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)) as defectCount from dual

select d.defect_name as defectName, count(*) as count from qc_defect_record r left join qc_defect d on r.defect_id = d.defect_id where r.create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by d.defect_name order by count desc limit 10

select workshop_name as workshopName, count(*) as workorderCount, sum(completed_quantity) as totalOutput, round(sum(completed_quantity) / sum(plan_quantity) * 100, 1) as completionRate from pro_workorder where status in ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') and create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by workshop_name order by totalOutput desc limit 10
